S2.description: Heals the target proportional to the caster's Attack and the target's max Health, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. Amount recovered is doubled when the target's Health is 50% or less.

S3.name: Attack Command
S3.description: Uses strengthening magic to increase Attack of all allies for 2 turns before recovering Health and dispelling one debuff. Amount recovered is proportional to the caster's Attack and the target's max Health.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Reaper's Scythe
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with Sigurd Scythe, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. When used on the caster's turn, activates Final Deliverance as an extra attack. Final Deliverance: Attacks all enemies, before granting stealth to the caster for 1 turn and decreasing skill cooldowns by 2 turns.

S2.name: Death's Dominion
S2.description: All Heroes cannot revive and cannot be granted immortality. When attacking, penetrates the target's Defense by 100%, and cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow.

S3.name: Inescapable Demise
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 3 turns, attacks the enemy by releasing the force of the netherworld. When the target is a hero, ignores damage share. Begins the first battle with a full skill cooldown count.

S1.name: Blunt Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy before increasing Combat Readiness of a random ally except for the caster by 15%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.
S1.soulburn_effect: Combat Readiness increase effect will be applied to all allies.

S2.name: Wild Swing
S2.description: Attacks the enemy before increasing Defense of the caster for 2 turns and recovers Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense, and amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Sword of Grace
S3.description: Adopts a counterattacking stance for 3 turns, and grants increased Speed and a barrier to all allies except for the caster for 2 turns. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Defense. After suffering an attack that targets all allies, decreases skill cooldown by 2 turns.

S1.name: Armor Rend
S1.description: Attacks with an axe, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Attack Chain
S2.description: Strongly slams the enemy with an axe, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns. A critical hit will extend any buffs granted to the caster by 1 turn.

S3.name: Cry of Victory
S3.description: Encourages allies, increasing Attack for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Lua Attack
S1.description: Attacks the enemy and has a 100% chance to provoke for 1 turn.

S2.name: Lua Squad
S2.description: After being attacked by a Hero, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 10% and makes all allies granted with challenge counterattack.

S3.name: Lua's Challenge
S3.description: Grants challenge to all allies, before increasing Defense of the caster for 2 turns. Decreases buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and has a 100% chance to provoke for 1 turn.

S1.name: Just One Bite! ♡
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by tearing up a food market, with a 100% chance to burn for 1 turn. When used on the caster's turn, Just One Bite! ♡ becomes an attack that targets all enemies. Changed attack is unaffected by elemental disadvantage and does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Let's Eat Together!
S2.description: Reduces the effect of decreased Combat Readiness debuffs inflicted on all allies by 50%. This skill effect does not stack with other passive skills of the same name. Increase Evasion by 35%, and when Health is 50% or more, increases Evasion by an additional 35%.

S3.name: Yufine's ☆ Special
S3.description: Dispels two debuffs from all allies and attacks all enemies in the middle of a night market. Increased Attack of all allies for 2 turns and Combat Readiness by 25%.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Ankle Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, recovering Health of the ally with the lowest Health. Amount recovered increases proportional to damage dealt.

S2.name: Defensive Spirit
S2.description: After suffering an attack that targets all allies, when the caster has a debuff, has a 100% chance to counterattack with Fiery Blade Gust. Fiery Blade Gust takes priority over a counterattack with a basic skill. This effect can only be activated once every 2 turns. Fiery Blade Gust: Attacks all enemies with a blade gust, and increases Speed of the caster for 1 turn.

S3.name: Explosive Cut
S3.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, decreasing Speed of the target for 2 turns and a 100% chance to decrease Defense of the target for 2 turns. Grants Willful Flame to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Staff Strike
S1.description: Attacks with a staff, with a 50% chance to silence for 1 turn.

S2.name: Dark Magic
S2.description: Decreases amount recovered of all enemies by 50%, and increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 20%. When the enemy uses a non-attack skill.

S3.name: Dark Explosion
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with dark magic, with a 100% chance to dispel all buff before decreasing Combat Readiness by 15%.

S1.name: Supersonic Kick
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a kick and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Grants an extra attack with the same skill.

S2.name: Prairie Hawk
S2.description: Increases Evasion by 50%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. At the start of the turn, increases Attack for 1 turn.

S3.name: Monarch's Flaming Strike
S3.description: Dispels all debuffs from the caster, and attacks the enemy with a secret technique before granting immunity and a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns. When the caster's Attack is greater than the target's Attack, penetrates Defense proportionally, up to 100%.

S1.name: Enhanced Fire
S1.description: Fires an enhanced pistol, with a 75% chance to dispel one buff from the enemy.

S2.name: Combat Support
S2.description: Supports all allies using an enhancement cube, granting increased Attack for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: High-Density Explosive Cube
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with powerful explosives, with a 100% chance to dispel one buff, before a 75% chance to decrease hit Chance for 2 turns. Grants the caster skill nullifier once.

S1.name: Rush
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When this skill is used, if it was not triggered by a Dual Attack, has a 50% chance to use Punish instead of Rush. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Punish
S2.description: Attacks the enemy by stabbing them, inflicting up to 20% injuries. A successful attack inflicts additional damage equivalent to 50% of injuries inflicted on the target. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Repel
S3.description: Attacks all enemies mercilessly, inflicting up to 20% injuries. Grants increased Critical Hit Damage to all allies for 2 turns, and grants immunity to the caster for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Swing
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with Ruyi Bang, and grants a barrier to the caster for 1 turn. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Attack. When used on the caster's turn, attacks all enemies. The changed attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: The Immortal One
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Resistance and Penetration Resistance by 50%. When attacked, if the caster suffers a non-critical hit, increases Attack and Speed by 20%. Can stack up to 3 times.

S3.name: Heavenly Fighter's Strike
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns, attacks the enemy and inflicts stun for 1 turn. When the caster's Attack is greater than the target's Attack, damage dealt increases proportionally, up to 70%. Unaffected by elemental disadvantage.

S1.name: Jealous Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with flames, with a 100% chance to burn for 1 turn. When the caster is granted vigor, ignores Effect Resistance

S2.name: Malicus's Power
S2.description: When attacked, damage suffered in one attack does not exceed 51% of max Health. After suffering an attack that targets all allies, dispels all debuffs from the caster and activates Blazing Fury. Blazing Fury: With an outraged cry, grants vigor to the caster for 2 turns, before recovering Health proportional to Attack and increasing Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Flames of Destruction
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with an inferno, dispelling all buffs before a 100% chance each to inflict two burn effects for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects. When the caster is granted vigor, ignores Effect Resistance.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Mysterious Design
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a staff, with a 40% chance to stun for 1 turn.

S2.name: Unbridled Potential
S2.description: With a mysterious power, dispels two debuffs from an ally except for the caster and grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by 40%.

S3.name: Matter Reconstruction
S3.description: Dispels all debuffs from all allies before granting a random buff for 2 turns for each debuff dispelled and recovers Health proportional to the caster's max Health. When this skill is not on cooldown, at the end of an enemy's turn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S1.name: Divine Punishment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and has a 75% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Cannot trigger a critical hit, and penetrates the target's Defense by 30%. After attacking, when the caster's Health is 30% or less, grants an extra attack with the same skill.

S2.name: Desperate Resolve
S2.description: Grants immortality for 1 turn and increased Attack for 2 turns to the caster. Upon receiving lethal damage when the skill is available according to cooldown count, grants the same effects to the caster and fully increases cooldown of this skill.

S3.name: Strike of Vengeance
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword. Cannot trigger a critical hit. A successful attack deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack to all enemies. Penetrates the target's Defense by 30%, and when the caster's Health is 30% or less, penetrates by 70%. When the caster is immortal, grants an extra turn.
S3.soulburn_effect: Increases damage dealt and additional damage.

S1.name: Refined Flower
S1.description: Throws swords at the enemy, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance by 50% and increases damage dealt. Does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Oathkeeper
S2.description: Resets skill cooldown of an ally except for the caster and grants increased Attack (Greater) for 2 turns with light energy. Grants an extra turn. This skill is unaffected by cooldown increase and decrease effects.

S3.name: Full Bloom
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a giant Magic Sword, dispelling all buffs, before making them unable to be buffed and decreasing Defense for 2 turns.

S1.name: Holy Light
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with holy light, and recovers Health of allies proportional to the target's max Health.

S2.name: Light of Repose
S2.description: Unaffected by decreases to Combat Readiness. At the start of the turn, dispels immortality from all enemies. Ignores Effect Resistance. At the end of someone's turn, when the enemy is granted immortality, spreads the censer's light to dispel all debuffs from all allies and grants radiance for 2 turns, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%

S3.name: Requiem Prayer
S3.description: Dispels two debuffs from all allies by offering a prayer to banish evil, and grants ignore sharing for 3 turns and immunity for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by 20%.

S1.name: Rabid Strike
S1.description: Dashes towards the enemy to attack. When the caster is enraged, damage dealt is increased.

S2.name: Ruler of the Prairie
S2.description: After any ally is attacked, the caster gains 10 Fighting Spirit per ally attacked, and has a 35% chance to activate Hour of the Hunt. Hour of the Hunt: Increases Speed of all allies for 2 turns, and the caster becomes enraged for 2 turns.

S3.name: Shatter
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Speed for 2 turns before increasing Attack of the caster for 2 turns. When the caster is enraged, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Staff Assault
S1.description: Attacks with a staff, with a 75% chance to decrease Hit Chance for 1 turn.

S2.name: Tailind
S2.description: 100% chance to dispel one debuff inflicted on an ally at the beginning of each turn.

S3.name: Gale
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with wind magic, granting continuous healing and increased Speed to all allies for 2 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Cold Blow
S1.description: Attacks with a staff, with a 35% chance to stun for 1 turn.

S2.name: Coerce
S2.description: Casts weakening magic, with a 100% chance each to decrease buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and inflict frostbite for 2 turns. Grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns.

S3.name: Cold Snap
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with frost magic, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns before a 100% chance to decrease Combat Readiness by 20%.

S1.name: Taste Test
S1.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy. When the caster is already granted rage, activates Bite as an extra attack. Bite can only be activated once per turn, during the caster's turn.

S2.name: Wild Dog Company Captain
S2.description: Upon receiving lethal damage, grants immortality to the caster for 1 turn. Immortality can only be activated once per battle. After being attacked, when Health is 50% or less, activates Plan A. Plan A can only be activated once every 4 turns. Plan A: Dispels all debuffs from the caster and becomes enraged for 2 turns, before increasing Combat Readiness by 50%.

S3.name: Bite
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack to all enemies except for the target. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Penetrates the target's Defense.

S1.name: Sever
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a scythe. Penetrates the target's Defense by 20%.

S2.name: End of Evil
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a scythe, dispelling all buffs before a 100% chance to inflict decreased Hit Chance for 2 turns and a 85% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 25% per target. This skill cannot trigger a counterattack.

S3.name: Wave of Light
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by distorting space and time before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Grants invincibility to the caster for 1 turn.

S1.name: Vulnerability Exposed
S1.description: Attacks with dual-wielded swords. When the caster is stealthed, has a 100% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn.

S2.name: Urgent Evasion
S2.description: At the moment the caster is attacked, has a 100% chance to become stealthed for 1 turn.

S3.name: Mark of Acceleration
S3.description: Increases the Combat Readiness of all allies by 30%, and grants stealth to the caster for 1 turn.

S1.name: Violent Beating
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a club and has a 75% chance to dispel one buff. When the caster has perception, increases effect chance to 100%.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100% and dispels two buffs from the target.

S2.name: Wicked Instinct
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 20 Fighting Spirit. The caster receives 30% of the damage suffered by the ally in the back row in their place. When more than one damage sharing effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied. When an enemy revives, gains 40 Fighting Spirit and grants perception to the caster for 2 turns. The effect upon an enemy's revival can only be activated once every 2 turns.

S3.name: Club Swing
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by swinging a club and has a 100% chance each to decrease Defense and make then unable to be buffed for 2 turns. Decreases debuff duration of all allies by 2 turns.

S1.name: Hammer Time
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a hammer, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When the caster is enraged, activates Rock Smash as an extra attack. Rock Smash can only be activated once per turn, during the caster's turn. Rock Smash: Attacks all enemies by slamming the ground, and inflicts bleeding for 2 turns. Ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Force Awakening
S2.description: Upon receiving lethal damage, grants immortality and vampirism for 1 turn and resets skill cooldown of Feast of Predation. Can be only activated once every 6 turns. After an ally attacks, if the target has a debuff, gains 10 Fighting Spirit and when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to make the caster enraged for 2 turns.

S3.name: Feast of Predation
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by unleashing their power, and grants increased Attack (Greater) to the caster for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the target.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Sequential Cutter
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by quick-drawing with a sword. A critical hit will decrease skill cooldown by 1 turn.

S2.name: Blade Art: Flash
S2.description: Attacks the enemy by rushing towards them. A critical hit will inflict decreased Defense on the target for 1 turn, and grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Blade Art: Thunder
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by slashing at lightning speed. A critical hit will increase damage dealt.

S1.name: Spatial Relocation
S1.description: Approaches the enemy through subspace and attacks, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When the caster is granted mana field, consumes 10 Fighting Spirit to attack a random enemy with the same skill as an extra attack.

S2.name: Dimensional Corridor
S2.description: Attacks the enemy in a dimensional corridor, with a 100% chance each to dispel two buffs before fully increasing skill cooldowns. A critical hit will grant an extra turn.

S3.name: Dimensional Explosion
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with an explosion and grants increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. At the start of the first battle, gains maximum Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is 10 or more during battle, grants mana field.

S1.name: Void Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, with a 50% chance to inflict decreased Hit Chance for 1 turn, dealing damage proportional to the caster's lost Health. When this skill is used, if it was not triggered by a Dual Attack and the caster has a buff, this skill changes into an attack that targets all enemies. The changed attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Immortal Will
S2.description: When the caster receives lethal damage, grants immortality for 1 turn and increased Evasion for 2 turns and resets skill cooldowns.

S3.name: Apocalypse
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with the Archdemon's Might contained within the sword, before absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health and granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns. When the enemy is defeated, extends buff durations granted to the caster by 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S1.name: Knockout
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a flurry of strikes and has a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns. When granted vigor, additionally inflicts burn on the target for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Celestial Kick
S2.description: Attacks the enemy with a series of kicks, decreasing Defense for 2 turns before granting the caster increased Speed for 2 turns. When the caster is granted vigor, ignores Effect Resistance. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Phoenix Flurry
S3.description: Attacks with a flurry of strikes before delivering a powerful blow, decreasing Attack for 2 turns and stunning for 1 turn. Grants vigor to the caster for 3 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. At the start of the first battle, gains 40 Fighting Spirit.

S1.name: Hey There!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with sharp sickles, with a 50% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. If the enemy is debuffed after the attack, a successful attack deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.

S2.name: Casual Introduction
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a flame guardian, before increasing Attack of all allies for 2 turns. Grants skill nullifier once to Fire elemental allies. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S3.name: Rough Welcome
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a flame guardian, dispelling two buffs before stunning for 1 turn. Increases Combat Readiness of Fire elemental allies by 20%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S1.name: Flame Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a ball of flame and has a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns. After attacking, has a 35% chance to activate Burning Vitality. Burning Vitality: Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S2.name: Composure
S2.description: After being attacked, when the caster has a debuff, dispels all debuffs and grants increased Attack for 2 turns.

S3.name: Emberstorm
S3.description: Attacks with a fiery explosion, making the target unhealable and decreasing Defense for 2 turns each.

S1.name: Auto-Fire
S1.description: Attacks with a gatling gun, with a 90% chance to dispel one buff. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

S2.name: Defense Mode
S2.description: Increases Defense of the caster by 10% after attacking. Effect can only stack up to 5 times.

S3.name: Cleaning Mode
S3.description: Fires indiscriminately at all enemies, with a 75% chance to decrease Hit Chance for 1 turn, before triggering counterattacks from the caster for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

S1.name: Venomous Arrow
S1.description: Fires a poisoned arrow at the enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict poison for 2 turns.

S2.name: Corrosive Volley
S2.description: Fires a corrosive volley to all enemies, extending any debuff duration by 1 turn.

S3.name: Preparation
S3.description: Strengthens the casters next attack, granting an extra turn. Venomous Arrow: Increases effect chance to 100%, and poison effects can be stacked up to 3 times. Corrosive Volley: Extends debuff duration by 2 turns.

S1.name: Full Moon Scythe
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a scythe. When the target has a buff, increases damage dealt by 70%.

S2.name: Dark Scar
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a scythe. Penetrates the enemy's Defense by 30%, and by an additional 30% when the caster is stealthed.

S3.name: Nocturne
S3.description: Leaps towards the enemy to attack and increases skill cooldowns by 1 turn twice. Grants stealth and a barrier (proportional to the caster's Attack) to the caster for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's current Health ratio.

S1.name: Get Away, Meow!
S1.description: Attacks with a morning star. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted loveliness, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Meow I'm Angry!
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a morning star while raging, with a 80% chance to decrease buff duration by 2 turns and make them unhealable for 2 turns. When the caster is granted loveliness, effect chance increases by 20%.

S3.name: I'm So Cute, Meow♥
S3.description: Wiggles tail cutely, decreasing debuff duration on all allies by 2 turns, and granting the caster immunity and loveliness for 3 turns. Grants the caster an extra turn.

S1.name: Aitan Beeeam! ☆
S1.description: Attacks by firing a heart at the enemy, before dispelling a debuff from an ally. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Dispels a debuff from all allies.

S2.name: Crisis Avoidance ♪
S2.description: Recovers Health of the ally with the lowest Health proportional to the caster's max Health at the end of the turn.

S3.name: Super Intelligent AI
S3.description: Cheers on allies, granting increased Attack and a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to all allies for 3 turns, before granting increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Light Step
S1.description: Strikes in the direction of the enemy, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

S2.name: Magic Resist
S2.description: Recovers 10% Health of the caster at the beginning of every turn.

S3.name: Fortitude
S3.description: Has a 100% chance to provoke and decrease Defense the enemy for 2 turns.

S1.name: Swordstorm
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a swordstorm, with a 75% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Charge
S2.description: Shoves the enemy with a shield, decreasing Combat Readiness by 50%, before granting increased Defense to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Summon Ziegfried
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by summoning the Guardian Ziegfried, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Penetrates Defense, but cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health. When this skill is not on cooldown, grants 25% damage share from the damage received by the ally.
S3.soulburn_effect: Decreases damage dealt and attacks all enemies.

S1.name: Divine Punishment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with divine lightning and has a 75% chance to inflict fear for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Scales of Equity
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants offering to the foremost ally. When the ally granted offering dies, recovers Health of all allies by 50%. When Combat Readiness of an enemy increases during battle, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50% of the amount of Combat Readiness increased. This effect will not be applied to the Combat Readiness increase effect triggered by the same skill.

S3.name: The Caress of Mercy
S3.description: With the Goddess's authority, dispels all debuffs from all allies before increasing Combat Readiness by 25%. Consumes 20% of the current Health of the ally granted offering, granting abundance to all other allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Sing with Me!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sweet melody, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When The Spirit of Rock is unavailable due to cooldown count, triggers a Dual Attack from a random ally. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Sweet Cheers
S2.description: Dispels all debuffs from all allies and increases Combat Readiness by 25%, before decreasing skill cooldowns of all allies except for the caster by 1 turn.

S3.name: The Spirit of Rock
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a bass. When the enemy is defeated, recovers Health of the caster and grants an extra turn. Penetrates the target's Defense, and cannot trigger a critical hit. Amount recovered and damage dealt increase proportional to the caster's max Health. Begins the first battle with full skill cooldown count, and when this skill is unavailable due to cooldown count, at the start of every turn, decreases all skill cooldowns by 1 turn.

S1.name: Fire
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with gunfire, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When the target has a buff, doubles the effects of Combat Readiness increase and Fighting Spirit gained.

S2.name: The Chief Is on the Scene
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 50 Fighting Spirit and grants stealth for 1 turn. At the start of the turn, gains 10 Fighting Spirit for each buff granted to an enemy, and when Fighting Spirit is full, resets skill cooldown. After attacking, increases Attack of the caster by 25%. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

S3.name: Full Burst
S3.description: Fires at all enemies to attack, and increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 25%, before granting a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns. When Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to penetrate the target's Defense by 50%. This skill cannot trigger a counterattack.

S1.name: Vacuum Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Phantom Strike
S2.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%, before granting stealth and a barrier (proportional to the caster's Attack) to the caster for 3 turns. Increases Hit Chance of this skill by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S3.name: Blade Art: Infinite Sword
S3.description: Becomes one with the sword, granting increased Attack and Phantom Sword to the caster for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Punishment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a swordstorm, before increasing Speed of the caster for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Code Number 00
S2.description: After being attacked, decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn. After suffering an attack that targets all allies, decreases skill cooldowns by an additional 1 turn, and grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to all allies for 2 turns.

S3.name: Mobile Weapon Ziegfried
S3.description: Summons Ziegfried to attack all enemies, before granting immunity to all allies for 2 turns and decreasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Penetrates Defense, but cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health and Speed. Damage dealt increases every time this skill is used and can stack up to 3 times.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Swift Fire
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a pistol, decreasing Combat Readiness by 15%. When the caster is granted exploiting weak points, uses Explosive Fire instead of Swift Fire. Explosive Fire: Attacks the enemy, decreasing buff durations by 1 turn and silencing for 1 turn before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Power of Harmony
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, when all allies are of different elements, acquires 10 Soul and has a 100% chance to increase Attack of all allies for 2 turns.

S3.name: Battle Preparation
S3.description: Increases Critical Hit Damage of all allies for 2 turns, and grants exploiting weak points to the caster. Grants an extra turn to the caster.

S1.name: You're Soft
S1.description: Attacks with a strong fist, increasing the caster's Combat Readiness by 20%.

S2.name: Power Strike
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 50%.

S3.name: Exposed!
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a powerful storm, decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%, before increasing Attack of the caster for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the enemy's lost Health.

S1.name: Sparrow Dive
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a slingshot, with a 35% chance to inflict stun for 1 turn.

S2.name: Fox Hunt
S2.description: Attacks with a slingshot, with a 100% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns, and a 50% chance to use Sparrow Dive.
S2.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S3.name: Flying Racoo
S3.description: Racoo attacks all enemies by firing bullets, inflicting decreased Speed for 2 turns and a 75% chance to inflict stun for 1 turn.

S1.name: Wave Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, before granting increased Speed to the caster for 1 turn. After attacking, when the target's omen is 3, consumes all, activating Call of the Abyss. Call of the Abyss: Calls forth a deep sea creature to attack the enemy, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction and recovers Health of all allies, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Cannot trigger a critical hit, and penetrates the target's Defense. Amount recovered and damage dealt increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Dreamer in the Deep
S2.description: Increases Health by 10%. Does not cost any Soul to activate the caster's first Soulburn. When attacking has a 100% chance to inflict one omen on the target.

S3.name: Freeze Over
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a frozen mass, decreasing buff durations by 2 turns before a 100% chance each to inflict frostbite and restrict for 2 turns. Ignores Effect Resistance of any targets with max Health lower than the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Wild Rose
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword and has a 80% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bleeding effects inflicted on the target.

S2.name: Thornbush
S2.description: Inflicts resource reduction on all enemies by 60% before attacking, dispelling all buffs and inflicting bind for 2 turns. For every target, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 25%.

S3.name: Public Execution
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a whip sword, inflicting decreased Defense for 2 turns before decreasing Combat Readiness by 100%. Grants skill nullifier once to all allies. When the target is inflicted with bind, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Follow Me! Charge!
S1.description: Takes the lead to attack the enemy, and triggers a Dual Attack from a random ally. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: That's Far Enough!
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 50%. After an enemy uses a non-attack skill, dispels all debuffs from the caster, and activates Suppression against the enemy caster. Suppression: Inflicts provoke on the target for 1 turn, and grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Ready, Load, Fire!
S3.description: Dispels all debuffs from all allies and commands the Perland Army to attack by firing on all enemies, before decreasing Combat Readiness by 25%. Inflicts damage according to the Attack of the ally with the highest Attack. When the target is provoked, damage dealt increases.

S1.name: Slice-Slice
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by slashing from above, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S2.name: Snip-Snip
S2.description: Attacks the enemy mercilessly, with a 100% chance to dispel all buffs. A critical hit will grant an extra turn.

S3.name: Soul Cutter
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by slashing them with Cho & Mal, before granting skill nullifier once to the caster, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Penetrates the target's Defense. Increase Hit Chance of this skill by 20%.

S1.name: Pinpoint Fire
S1.description: Attacks the enemy and has a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Technical Support
S2.description: Increases Attack of the caster and the ally with the highest Attack except for the caster for 2 turns and Combat Readiness by 30%. When Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Attack except for the caster is 35% or less, increases Combat Readiness of the targeted ally by an additional 50%.

S3.name: Ace in the Hole
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a grenade, with a 100% each to decrease Attack and Speed for 2 turns. When the target is of the Ice element, increases Speed of all allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Can You Handle The Heat?
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and grants increased Speed to the caster for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

S2.name: It's Far From Over!
S2.description: After an ally suffers an extra attack, counterattack, or Dual Attack, dispels all debuffs inflicted on the caster and activates Shine!. Shine!: Emits light, granting increased Defense and immunity to the caster for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 50% before resetting skill cooldowns.

S3.name: I Am The Victor!
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a sword blast, before granting an extra turn. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense. Begins the first battle with full cooldown count.

S1.name: 光の源
S1.description: 光で敵を攻撃し、味方全員のHPを回復する。発動者の最大HPに比例して与ダメージと回復量がアップする。

S2.name: 献身
S2.description: 最初のバトル開始時、神性効果を四つ付与する。発動者を除く味方が死亡すると、神性を一つ消費して2ターンの間生命の欠片として復活させ、行動ゲージを30%増加させる。

S3.name: 収束する時
S3.description: 世界を再構築して味方全員のHPを全回復し、3ターンの間スピードアップを付与する。発動者に神性が付与されている場合、発動者を除く味方全員に時間逆行を付与する。このスキルはクールタイムの増減効果を受けない。

S1.name: Judgment
S1.description: Attacks with a giant sword before granting the caster immunity for 1 turn. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

S2.name: A Queen's Dignity
S2.description: Immune to debuffs which prevent movement. When an ally is attacked, grants 20% damage reduction. After every attack suffered by an ally, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 10%.

S3.name: The Will of La Mare
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by slamming down with a sword, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. A successful attack always results in a critical hit, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack to all enemies except for the target. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. When the target is of the Dark element, increases damage dealt.
S3.soulburn_effect: Increases Hit Chance by 100% when using this skill.

S1.name: Delicate Crescent
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a fan, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and inflicts up to 10% injuries. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases damage dealt, and injuries can be inflicted up to 20%.

S2.name: Waxing Crescent
S2.description: For every surviving ally, increases Evasion by 15%. When an ally is attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, activates All Eyes on Me. All Eyes on Me (consumes 100 Fighting Spirit): Attacks all enemies, inflicting up to 15% injuries, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 30%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

S3.name: Quixotic Crescent
S3.description: After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks the enemy by moving unpredictably, and grants immunity to the caster for 2 turns. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

S1.name: Bash
S1.description: Attack the enemy, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. A successful attack deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Time to Rampage
S2.description: Increases Evasion by 50%. At the start of the turn, increases Attack by 20%, and can stack up to 5 times. At the end of the turn, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 10%.

S3.name: Hound the Indolent
S3.description: Dispels two debuffs from all allies before granting rampage to Dark elemental allies for 3 turns. Grants swift attack to all allies except for the caster. Grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Sharp Blow
S1.description: Knocks the enemy into the air with a spear, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S2.name: Spiritual Armament
S2.description: Increases Effect Resistance by 50%. Increases Attack by 15% each time the caster attacks an enemy. Effect can only stack up to 5 times.

S3.name: Resolve
S3.description: After leaping into the air, attacks the enemy with a strike from above. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Holy Light
S1.description: Attacks with a light sphere, with a 75% chance to decrease Attack for 1 turn.

S2.name: Regen
S2.description: With recovery magic, recovers Health of an ally proportional to the target's max Health and increases Combat Readiness by 100%. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 30%.

S3.name: Serenity
S3.description: With strengthening magic, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 20% before granting continuous healing for 3 turns and recovering Health proportional to the target's max Health.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 2 turns.

S1.name: Folding Fan
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a fan, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Butterfly Reverie
S2.description: Attacks the enemy with light, dispelling two buffs before putting them to sleep for 1 turn. Grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: Sweet Talk
S3.description: Dispels one buff from all enemies before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn and inflicting beguile. Increases Speed of all allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Paper Throw
S1.description: Throws paper to attack the enemy, with a 50% chance to restrict for 2 turns.

S2.name: Paper Whirlwind
S2.description: Attacks all enemies, with a 100% chance each to restrict and decrease Speed for 2 turns.

S3.name: Paper Barrier
S3.description: Uses many sheets of paper to recover Health of all allies and grant a barrier for 2 turns, before decreasing debuff durations by 1 turn. Amount recovered and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Starlight
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with magic, before a 75% chance to steal one buff. After attacking, when the caster has a buff, increases Combat Readiness by 15%.

S2.name: Moonlight Blow
S2.description: Attacks the enemy with light, decreasing buff durations by 1 turn before a 100% chance to stun for 1 turn. Grants invincibility to the caster for 1 turn and increases Combat Readiness by 50%.

S3.name: Call of the Full Moon
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with Nocturne magic, and when an enemy is defeated, extends the caster's buff durations by 1 turn. Penetrates the target's Defense by 30%. When the caster is invincible, penetrates the target's Defense by an additional 30%.

S1.name: Wild Wave
S1.description: Attacks with intense elemental force, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the enemy's lost Health.

S2.name: Rekos's Blessing
S2.description: With the blessing of the stars, grants increased Defense and a barrier (proportional to the caster's Attack) to all allies for 2 turns.
S2.soulburn_effect: All skill cooldowns decreased by 2 turns.

S3.name: Wave of Vengeance
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with the power of ruin, with a 100% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns, before increasing the caster's Attack. Increased Attack can stack up to 3 times.

S1.name: Infinity Slash
S1.description: Stabs the target a random number of times. Skill cooldown decreases by 1-3 turns and damage dealt increases according to the number of attacks.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases the number of attacks to max.

S2.name: Dragon Knight's Will
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance and Critical Hit Resistance by 30%. When the caster's Health is 50% or more, increases Attack by 30%, and when the caster's Health is less than 50%, increases Defense by 30%.

S3.name: Ragnar Spear
S3.description: Soars into the air and attacks the enemy by hurling a spear, with a 100% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50% and attacks using an elemental advantage. When the enemy is defeated, gains an additional 5 Soul.

S1.name: Mana Bullet
S1.description: Attacks with light energy, before a 75% chance to decrease Hit Chance for 1 turn.

S2.name: Celebration of Light
S2.description: Recites the Celebration of Light, recovering the Health of all allies and granting continuous healing and increased Defense for 2 turns. Amount recovered is proportional to the target's max Health.
S2.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S3.name: Primal Light
S3.description: Dispels one debuff from an ally with light magic, before recovering their Health and increasing their Combat Readiness by 50% with light magic. Amount recovered is proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Heavy Strike
S1.description: Attacks with a hammer, with a 40% chance to stun for 1 turn, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. After attacking, when the target is inflicted with stun, increases Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 15%.

S2.name: Maid's Cheer
S2.description: Grants 50% additional damage reduction to all allies. At the start of the turn, recovers Health of two allies with the lowest Health proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: VIP Treatment
S3.description: Entertains all allies with VIP Treatment, reviving all dead allies to 30% Health. For allies that are not dead, dispels two debuffs and grants revive for 3 turns, before granting increased Defense of all allies for 3 turns.

S1.name: Knockout
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a flurry of strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict provoke for 1 turn. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

S2.name: Dragon Flame
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants vigor for 3 turns. When an ally except for the caster suffers a critical hit, counterattacks, and when the caster suffers a critical hit, counterattacks with Dragon Flame. Dragon Flame (gains 1 Soul): Attacks the enemy with a kick and penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit, and damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S3.name: The Coming of Asura

S2.description: When attacked, has a 30% chance to counterattack. When counterattacking, activates Get Lost!. Get Lost! (gains 1 Soul): Attacks all enemies with a great sword. S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and recovers Health of the caster. When Pernilla is on the ally team, triggers a Dual Attack from Pernilla. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's Attack.

S3.name: Desperate
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, dispelling two buffs and decreasing Defense for 2 turns.

S3.name: Instant Blade

S2.description: Buffs and debuffs applied to the caster become Dirge Bullets. After using a skill on the caster's turn, when the caster has a Dirge Bullet, uses Dirge Bullet on a random enemy. Dirge Bullet (Gains 1 Focus): Attacks the enemy with a pistol. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense. Damage dealt and attack count increase proportional to the number of Dirge Bullets granted.

S1.description: Attacks the enemy with magic, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn. Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and a successful attack will inflict additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.

S1.name: 半月斬り / 欠け月斬り
