S2.name: Explosive Gentleman
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 3 Focus. After making a critical hit, increases Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 25%.

S3.name: Rifle Shot
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a rifle and decreases Combat Readiness by 30%. When Focus is full, consumes it all, increasing damage dealt and ignoring Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Graceful Gesture
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with phantoms, dispelling one buff. When the caster is enraged, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Phantom's Waltz
S2.description: Decreases the amount of resources gained by the enemy by 50%. At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, has a 100% chance to grant stealth for 1 turn.

S3.name: Fanatic Ball
S3.description: Hosts a ball, making all allies enraged for 2 turns. Dispels two buffs from all enemies and decreases Speed for 2 turns before decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%.

S1.name: Repel
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a chain axe, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn. When the caster is granted rage, activates Eradication as an extra attack. Eradication: Attacks the enemy, inflicting bleed for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates bleed effects inflicted on the target. Ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Abyss Observer
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, grants stealth to the caster for 1 turn. At the end of someone's turn, when an enemy is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, grants rage to the caster for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Unexpected Accident
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns, attacks all enemies by staging an accident, inflicting three bleeding effects for 1 turn. When the target is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, extends duration of bleed inflicted on the target by 1 turn. When the caster is granted rage, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Watch Out
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a fan, with a 75% chance to target the enemy for 2 turns.

S2.name: I'm with My Friends
S2.description: For every surviving ally, decreases damage suffered by 10%. When more than one damage reduction effect of the same kind is granted, only the strongest effect is applied. When an ally is attacked, gains 1 Focus, and when the caster's stacked Focus is 5, consumes all Focus and activates You're Not Cute. You're Not Cute: Attacks all enemies with a fan, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S3.name: Haven't I Warned You?
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a spray of water, dispelling all buffs before a 100% chance each to inflict cannot buff and unhealable for 2 turns.

S1.name: Spear of Vengeance
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, with a 75% chance to provoke for 1 turn. When it is not the caster's turn, effect chance increases by 25%.

S2.name: Indomitable Spirit
S2.description: Increases Attack by 30% and Critical Hit Resistance by 50%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. When attacked, if the caster suffers a non-critical hit, inflicts damage on the attacker proportional to the caster's Attack, before activating Grace of the Battlefield. Grace of the Battlefield: Grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's Attack) to all allies for 2 turns, and grants increased Speed of the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Dragon Slayer's Strike
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by striking downwards with a spear and has a 100% chance to decrease Hit Chance for 2 turns and a 85% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Adopts a counterattacking stance for 3 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Ankle Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Crystal Clear Soul
S2.description: When the ally with the highest Attack starts their turn, gains 1 Focus. After attacking on the caster's turn, when Focus is full, consumes all Focus, activating Glacial Strike. Glacial Strike: Attacks all enemies, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns, and grants Torrent to the ally with the highest Attack.

S3.name: Frozen Winter Cut
S3.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, with a 100% chance to decrease Speed for 2 turns, and increases Speed of all allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Seduction
S1.description: Attacks with a flame of seduction, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Spirit Absorb
S2.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 75% chance to decrease Attack for 2 turns, and when the enemy is defeated, resets skill cooldowns. Grants increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health.

S3.name: Flame Kiss
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with the flame of Chatty, the magic lantern, with a 100% chance each to inflict two burn effects for 2 turns.

S1.name: Horizontal Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Surpressed Desire
S2.description: Increases Evasion of all allies by 30%, and when an ally except for the caster evades, counterattacks. After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all, granting Demon Blade Unleashed to the caster for 1 turn before activating Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom. Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom: Consumes all Health to attack all enemies, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S3.name: Rouge Aroma
S3.description: Dispels all buffs from all enemies before inflicting beguile and inflicting decreased Hit Chance for 2 turns. Ignores Effect Resistance of targets with less max Health than the caster.

S1.name: Dark Shadow
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with dark energy, making them unhealable for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the enemy's lost Health.

S2.name: Die Hard
S2.description: When attacked, damage suffered in one attack does not exceed 51% of max Health. After an ally except for the caster attacks, when the target's Health is 30% or less, activates Encroach. Encroach: Attacks all enemies by releasing dark energy, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 30%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's lost Health.

S3.name: Conviction
S3.description: Inflicts lethal damage on the enemy. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction, and inflicts additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack on all enemies except for the target. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's lost Health.

S1.name: Weakening Blow
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 75% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

S2.name: Will
S2.description: At the moment the caster is attacked, increases Defense of the caster. At the moment of every fourth attack suffered, increases Defense of all allies for 2 turns. The caster's increased Defense can stack up to 3 times.

S3.name: Perceptive Slash
S3.description: Concentrates in order to dispel one debuff from all allies before attacking the enemy, provoking for 1 turn and granting all allies a barrier for 2 turns. Damage dealt and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's Defense.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Sequential Cutter
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword. When the target's Health is 50% or more, has a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn, and when the target's Health is less than 50%, has a 75% chance to inflict unhealable for 1 turn.

S2.name: Spear of Darkness
S2.description: Leaps into the air and strikes at the enemy with a swordstorm, dispelling one buff and inflicting decreased Defense for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Goddess of Ruin
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to all allies for 2 turns, attacks all enemies with the Portent of Destruction, decreasing Combat Readiness by 25% and increasing Combat Readiness of all allies by 25%. When there are three or fewer enemies, damage dealt increases with fewer enemies.

S1.name: Summon Household
S1.description: Summons different familiars to attack the enemy, inflicting injuries. The severity of injuries increases proportional to the damage dealt. Injuries decrease max Health of the target by up to 10% every time this skill is used.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases damage dealt and injuries decrease max Health of the target by up to 20%.

S2.name: True Vampire
S2.description: Damage suffered in one attack does not exceed 51% of max Health. At the start of the turn, when the caster's Health is 60% or more, increases Attack for 1 turn. At the end of the turn, grants stealth for 1 turn.

S3.name: Purifying Javelin
S3.description: Dispels all buffs from the enemy and attacks with a gigantic javelin of white silver. Increases Hit Chance by 100% when using this skill. Ignores Effect Resistance of any targets with Attack lower than the caster's Attack.

S1.name: How Fragile
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict venom for 1 turn. After attacking, when the target is inflicted with venom, increases skill cooldowns by 1 turn.

S2.name: Just Trust Me
S2.description: At the end of an enemy's turn, for each buff granted to the enemy, has a 5% chance to increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 25%. At the end of the turn, grants a a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to the ally with the highest Attack except for the caster for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 25%.

S3.name: May You Perish
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, decreasing buff durations by 2 turn before inflicting decreased Speed and two venom effects for 2 turns. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

S1.name: Cold Blow
S1.description: Attacks with a staff, with a 35% chance to stun for 1 turn.

S2.name: Coerce
S2.description: Casts weakening magic, with a 100% chance each to decrease buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and inflict frostbite for 2 turns. Grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns.

S3.name: Punishing Light
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with frost magic, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns before a 100% chance to decrease Combat Readiness by a random amount between 20% and 40%.

S1.name: Crimson Claws
S1.description: After inflicting rupture on the enemy for 1 turn, attacks the enemy. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Noias's Guidance
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants immortality for 1 turn. When granted immortality, increases Effect Resistance by 200%. When someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating Dark Moon. Dark Moon: Dispels two buffs from all enemies, before granting immortality to the caster for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 50%.

S3.name: Endless Darkness
S3.description: After inflicting seal on all enemies for 2 turns, attacks them and decreases Combat Readiness by 30%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, ignores Effect Resistance. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Magic Design
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a staff, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Hit Chance for 1 turn.

S2.name: Resurrection Magic
S2.description: Revives a dead ally with magic and grants increased Attack and immortality for 1 turn. When the target is not dead, grants increased Attack and immortality for 3 turns.

S3.name: Sparkling Star
S3.description: With recovery magic, dispels all debuffs from an ally and the caster and increases Health ratios to the higher of the two before additionally recovering Health proportional to the target's max Health. Health ratio increase effect is unaffected by increased or decreased healing effects.

S1.name: Magicule Explosion
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by manipulating magicules and recovers Health of all allies. Damage dealt and amount recovered increase proportional to the caster's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Grants an extra attack with the same skill.

S2.name: Blooming Lotus
S2.description: Dispels two debuffs from all allies and redistributes Health so that each ally has an equal Health ratio before granting a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) for 2 turns.

S3.name: Sleeping Spell
S3.description: With scattering petals, dispels two buffs from all enemies before a 85% chance to inflict sleep for 1 turn and a 100% chance to inflict decreased Attack for 2 turns.

S1.name: Sever
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a scythe, with a 50% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns.

S2.name: Smash
S2.description: Attacks the enemy by swiping consecutively with a scythe, with a 100% chance each to inflict unhealable and bleeding for 2 turns. After attacking, when the target's Health is 50% or less, activates Sever as an extra attack. When attacking with an extra attack, Sever has a 100% chance to inflict bleeding.

S3.name: Guillotine
S3.description: Inflicts lethal damage to the enemy, piercing their Weakness. Penetrates Defense by 30%, with an additional 10% for each debuff inflicted on the enemy. Inflicts extinction when the enemy is defeated.

S1.name: Single Shot
S1.description: Shoots arrows at the enemy, decreasing their Combat Readiness by 10%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Concentration
S2.description: At the start of the turn, gains 1 Focus. When attacked, consumes 1 Focus, dispelling one debuff from the caster and increasing Combat Readiness by 15%. When the caster's Focus is 2 or more, uses Automatic Fire instead of Single Shot. Automatic Fire: Attacks the enemy with arrows, decreasing Combat Readiness by 10%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed, and penetrates the target's Defense by 20%. This attack receives effects that are applied to the basic skill.

S3.name: Storm Arrow
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with wind, with a 100% chance to decrease Speed for 2 turns, and granting increased Speed to all allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Flame Friction
S1.description: Attacks an enemy with an explosion of flames, with a 75% chance to burn for 1 turn. After attacking, when an enemy is burned, activates Flame Release as an extra attack. Flame Release: Attacks all enemies with fire energy, with a 60% chance to burn for 1 turn, before detonating burn effects inflicted on the target at the end of the turn.
S1.soulburn_effect: Effect Chance of Flame Friction increases to 100%, and ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Flame of Savara
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases Attack proportional to Effectiveness. The rate of the increase Attack effect does not change after it is activated. At the end of an ally except for the caster's turn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%.

S3.name: Meteor Fall
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a giant meteor, inflicting two burn effects for 2 turns and stunning for 1 turn. Decreases Combat Readiness of the enemy with the highest Combat Readiness by 30%.

S1.name: 守護の剣
S1.description: 敵を攻撃し、75%の確率で1ターンの間挑発を付与する。発動者の最大HPに比例して与ダメージがアップする。

S2.name: 誓いの盾
S2.description: 攻撃された後、発動者に弱体効果がなければ、発動者と後列の味方の行動ゲージを20%増加させる。ターンごとに一度のみ発動できる。最初のバトル開始時、後列の味方の効果抵抗を発動者の効果抵抗の100%分アップさせる。この効果の数値は発動後に変化せず、後列の味方が倒れたときのみ解除される。発動者が後列にいる場合、効果は発動しない。

S3.name: 竜騎士の声援
S3.description: 2ターンの間味方全員の攻撃力をアップさせる。2ターンの間発動者の防御力と効果命中をアップさせ、HPを回復する。発動者の最大HPに比例して回復量がアップする。
S3.soulburn_effect: スキルのクールタイムが2ターン短縮される。

S1.name: Debilitating Strike
S1.description: Attacks the target with a staff, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When the caster is immortal, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and decreases Defense of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Soul Harvest
S2.description: Enemies cannot revive. Every time an enemy dies, recovers Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.

S3.name: Dark Salvation
S3.description: Whips up a vortex of darkness and loathing, dispelling two debuffs from all allies, before granting immortality to the caster for 2 turns, and increases Attack and Speed of all allies except for the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Gunflame
S1.description: Attacks an enemy with pillars of fire. When the target does not have a buff, increases damage dealt. After attacking, when the caster's Fighting Spirit is 100, activates Roman Cancel. Does not activate when counterattacking. Roman Cancel: Consumes all Fighting Spirit and extends buff durations of the caster by 1 turn before granting an extra turn.

S2.name: Volcanic Viper
S2.description: When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20% and gains 20 Fighting Spirit. When suffering an attack that targets all allies, activates Volcanic Viper against the attacker. This effect is not activated by a counterattack, Dual Attack, or extra attack. Each effect can only be activated once every 2 turns. Volcanic Viper (gains 2 Soul): Launches the enemy into the air and attacks repeatedly, inflicting silence for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S3.name: Tyrant Rave ver. Beta
S3.description: Attacks the target with a strong punch, dispelling all buffs and inflicts cannot buff for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health. After attacking, deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack regardless of whether the attack hits.

S1.name: Pew, Pew, Pew!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a staff, with a 75% chance to dispel one buff. When the caster is granted daydream, activates Fwooooosh— Ha! as an extra attack. Fwooooosh— Ha!: Attacks all enemies with mana, with a 25% chance to inflict stun for 1 turn.

S2.name: I Wanna Go Home...
S2.description: Decreases the amount of Focus gained by the enemy by 100%. At the start of the turn, has a 100% chance to grant daydream for 1 turn, and at the end of the turn, has a 100% chance to grant stealth for 1 turn.

S3.name: Boom! Starlight Fall!
S3.description: Decreases buff durations of the enemy by 1 turn and attacks with starlight, inflicting stun for 1 turn before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to the caster for 2 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn and grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Surpressing Fire
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with cover fire, before granting a barrier to the ally except for the caster with the lowest Health for 2 turns. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Recovery
S2.description: Recovers the target's Health using a recovery cube and dispels two debuffs. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
S2.soulburn_effect: Effect is granted to all allies.

S3.name: Cube Aura
S3.description: Uses a recovery cube to grant all allies immunity for 2 turns, before recovering Health. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Dreamy Iron Mace
S1.description: Attacks with an iron mace, with a 50% chance to stun for 1 turn. When the target is stunned after the attack, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 25%. Increases Effectiveness of this attack by 50%.

S2.name: Evil Claws
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with evil claws, with a 80% chance to stun for 1 turn, before granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns and increasing the caster's Combat Readiness by 50%. Increases Effectiveness of this attack by 50%.,

S3.name: Light Storm
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a light storm, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction and resets cooldown of this skill. Penetrates the target's Defense by 30%, but when the enemy is inflicted with stun, penetrates by 100%. When this skill is not on cooldown, increases Evasion by 50%.

S1.name: Poison Blast
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with an explosion of poison energy and has a 70% chance to inflict poison for 2 turns. This skill cannot trigger a counterattack. When Endless Nightmare is on cooldown, attacks two enemies including the target.

S2.name: Nightmare Illusion
S2.description: Illusion will remain throughout the battle. Increases Attack and Defense of the caster by 10% every time somebody dies. Effect can only stack up to 5 times.

S3.name: Endless Nightmare
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a nightmare crystal, inflicting stun for 1 turn. When the enemy is defeated, decreases Combat Readiness of all remaining enemies by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Mighty Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sheath. When this skill is used, if it was not triggered by a Dual Attack and the caster has a buff, uses Nimble Sword instead. Nimble Sword: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 1 turn, swiftly attacks the enemy, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Sixth Sense
S2.description: When attacked, damage suffered in one attack does not exceed 51% of max Health. When someone dies, decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn and gains 5 Soul. Effects upon death are only activated upon a Hero's death.

S3.name: Spirit Gate: Burning Possession
S3.description: Opens the gate of the spirits to revive all dead allies. Dispels all debuffs from all allies before granting immortality for 1 turn, and grants possession to the caster for 3 turns.

S1.name: Vanguard's Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe and inflicts provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Master's Lessons
S2.description: When an ally is attacked, gains 10 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, activates Warrior's Strike on the attacker. Warrior's Strike (consumes 100 Fighting Spirit): Attacks the enemy consecutively, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50% before resetting cooldown of Lightning Strike. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Lightning Strike
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by slamming down with an axe. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Damage dealt increases every time this skill is used, stacking up to 3 times.

S1.name: 強力な一撃
S1.description: 剣を振るって敵を攻撃し、発動者の行動ゲージを20%増加させる。

S2.name: 破滅の眼差し
S2.description: 力の波動で敵全体を攻撃し、強化効果をすべて解除する。発動者より攻撃力が低い対象の効果抵抗を無視する。敵が三体以下の場合、敵が少ないほど与ダメージがアップする。
S2.soulburn_effect: スキルのクールタイムが2ターン短縮される。

S3.name: 星の消滅
S3.description: 剣で敵全体を攻撃し、発動者に1ターンの間無敵を付与する。最大HPが最も高い対象の防御力を貫通する。このスキルでは反撃を誘発できない。

S1.name: Lan Na Zha
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. When this skill is used, if it was not triggered by a Dual Attack and the caster is granted possession, activates Roaring Spiritfall instead. Roaring Spiritfall: Increases Attack of the caster for 2 turns, before attacking the enemy by striking from above. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Spirit Invocation
S2.description: Starts the first battle with 60 Fighting Spirit. When Combat Readiness of an enemy is decreased, gains Fighting Spirit equal to the amount of Combat Readiness reduced, and at the end of a turn, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 100% and granting possession for 2 turns.

S3.name: Azure Phantom
S3.description: Unleashes power, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and a 85% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns, before granting invincibility to the caster for 1 turn. When the caster is granted possession, extends buff durations of the caster by 1 turn and grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Caught A Big One
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with two meaty fish and has a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When activated as a Dual Attack, this attack changes into an attack that targets all enemies. The changed attack does not trigger a counterattack, and increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 20%.
S1.soulburn_effect: Attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack or counterattack.

S2.name: An Adult's Responsibility
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 30%. At the start of the first battle, gains 60 Fighting Spirit and grants enhanced Dual Attack to the caster. At the end of every 4 ally turns, grants enhanced Dual Attack to the caster.

S3.name: Whale, Hello There
S3.description: Dispels all debuffs from the caster, and attacks the enemy with a pod of killer whales, stunning for 1 turn, before increasing Speed of all allies for 2 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

S1.name: Fell
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by cutting with dual-wielded swords. A critical hit will activate Lightning Bolt as an extra attack. Lightning Bolt can only be activated once per turn of the caster. Lightning Bolt (Acquire 1 Soul): Rapidly attacks the enemy by cutting with dual-wielded swords.

S2.name: Cold Edge
S2.description: Attacks the enemy with a cold blade, with a 100% chance to inflict two poison effects for 2 turns, and increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Glistening Summer Strike
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a powerful spike, and increases Attack of the caster for 3 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Are you the Culprit?
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with swords, with a 75% chance each to dispel one buff twice.

S2.name: Suppression Attempt
S2.description: Attack increases by 50%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit. Does not cost any Souls to activate the caster's first Soulburn. After an ally except for the caster uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates Suppress!. Can only be activated once every 3 turns. Suppress!: Increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 15% and plants a bomb on two random enemies for 2 turns.

S3.name: Sword of Flowers!
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, decreasing Attack for 2 turns and increases Speed of the caster for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the enemy.

S1.name: Chain Dagger
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a chain axe. When the enemy is inflicted with bleeding, inflicts two bleeding effects for 2 turns.

S2.name: Edge Smash
S2.description: Attacks the enemy consecutively with a chain axe, inflicting two to four bleeding effects for 2 turns anddecreased Attack for 1 turn.

S3.name: Implosion
S3.description: Attacks the inner core of the enemy with a chain axe. Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of bleeding effects inflicted on the target and extends debuff durations by 1 turn. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15% per bleeding effect inflicted on the target, by up to 75%.

S1.name: Shadow Tracking
S1.description: Attacks the enemy and has a 50% chance to burn for 2 turns.

S2.name: Belated Bloom
S2.description: After attacking, increases Attack and Effectiveness of the caster by 5%. Can stack up to 10 times.

S3.name: Shadow Release
S3.description: Releases mana to attack all enemies and has a 100% chance to make them unhealable for 2 turns and inflict two burn effects for 2 turns.

S1.name: Wicked Strike
S1.description: Attacks with dual-wielded swords, and when the caster's Health is 50% of less, activates Repelling Blow as an extra attack. Repelling Blow can only be activated once per turn of the caster. Repelling Blow (Acquire 1 Soul): Attacks the enemy repeatedly with dual-wielded swords. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S2.name: Potential
S2.description: Grants immortality for 1 turn and increases Attack for 2 turn when the caster receives lethal damage. Can only be activated once every 4 turns.

S3.description: Attacks all enemies and inflicts huge damage. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S1.name: 旗手の一撃
S1.description: 旗で敵を攻撃し、75%の確率で1ターンの間沈黙を付与する。攻撃後、対象が沈黙状態なら対象の行動ゲージを25%減少させる。

S2.name: 標的固定
S2.description: 敵の強化効果をすべて解除した後、100%の確率で2ターンの間標的を付与し、発動者を除く味方全員に通常スキルで攻撃させる。発動者の行動ゲージを30%増加させる。

S3.name: 勝利の旗
S3.description: 敵全体の強化効果を二つ解除した後、100%の確率で2ターンの間恐怖を付与し、行動ゲージを20%減少させる。味方全員に2ターンの間スピードアップを付与する。最初のバトル開始時、発動者に2ターンの間回避アップを付与する。

S1.name: Mana Attunment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with mana, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 15% and increasing Attack by 20%. Increased Attack effect can stack up to 3 times. On the caster's turn, when Focus is full, activates the same skill as an extra attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Insight
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, fully recovers Focus, and at the end of the turn, gains 1 Focus. When Focus is 3 or higher, immune to debuffs. When attacked, if expected damage suffered is equivalent to 30% or more of max Health, consumes 1 Focus, granting 70% damage reduction. Insight only applies to PVP.

S3.name: Nature's Judgment
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by bringing forth the power of nature, before decreasing skill cooldowns of all allies by 1 turn and recovering Health proportional to the caster's Attack.

S1.name: Sweep
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a blade, with a 80% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns, and when the caster is granted overload, increases effect chance by 20%. At the end of the turn, detonates bleeding effects inflicted on the target.

S2.name: Guard
S2.description: After an ally except for the caster uses a Single Attack, grants swift attack to the ally target, and activates Flank Strike against the enemy target. This effect is not activated by an extra attack, counterattack, or Dual Attack. Flank Strike: Attacks the enemy's flank, dispelling one buff and inflicting decreased Defense for 2 turns, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Assault
S3.description: After granting overload to the caster for 2 turns, attacks all enemies with maximum output, dispelling two buffs, and has a 100% chance each to inflict a bomb and frostbite for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Full Moon Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. When the caster is enraged, activates Tidal Crash as an extra attack. Tidal Crash can only be activated once per turn, during the caster's turn. Tidal Crash: Attacks the enemy by slashing downwards with a spear. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increase damage dealt by Full Moon Slash.

S2.name: Azure Waves Of The Ocean
S2.description: After an enemy uses a non-attack skill, dispels all debuffs from the caster and becomes enraged for 3 turns and grants skill nullifier once to the caster. Can only be activated once every 3 turns.

S3.name: Tornado Sweep
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, dispelling all buffs, and increases skill cooldowns of the target with the highest Attack by 1 turn twice. Grants increased Attack and Speed to the caster for 2 turns. When the caster is enraged, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Casual Introduction
S1.description: Attacks the enemy and has a 60% chance to provoke for 1 turn.

S2.name: Street Fighter
S2.description: When attacked, has a 40% chance to counterattack. After attacking with a basic skill, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 100% and fully decrease cooldown of Soulful Strike.

S3.name: Soulful Strike
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with full power, and increases Defense of the caster for 2 turns. When the target is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, increases damage dealt.

S1.name: Ready to Pounce
S1.description: Attacks the enemy and has a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Casual Cheer
S2.description: Grants immunity to an ally and the caster for 2 turns, and grants a barrier to all allies for 2 turns. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Attack.

S3.name: Break Apart
S3.description: Attacks the enemy's vital point, with a 100% chance to dispel two buffs and make them unable to be buffed for 2 turns. This skill cannot trigger a counterattack.

S1.name: Serene Tune
S1.description: (Tamarinne) Attacks an enemy with a serene melody before recovering Health of the ally with the lowest Health proportional to the target's max Health. Decreases cooldown of Shining Star☆ by 1 turn. (Idol) Attacks all enemies with a beautiful voice and dispels all buffs. Triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Greatly recovers Health of all allies after attacking.

S2.name: Song of the Forest
S2.description: (Tamarinne) With a peaceful melody, recovers Health of all allies proportional to the caster's max Health. Decreases cooldown of Shining Star☆ by 1 turn. (Idol) With a powerful performance, grants increased Attack to all allies for 2 turns, increases Combat Readiness by 50%, and recovers Health proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Shining Star☆
S3.description: Before performing, dispels all debuffs inflicted on all allies and recovers the caster to max Health and grants an extra turn. The caster becomes an idol for 3 turns and performs a concert. Begins the first battle with full cooldown count.

S1.name: Spear Art
S1.description: Knocks the enemy into the air with a spear, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn.

S2.name: Discipline
S2.description: Increases the chance of Dual Attack by 10%. Combat Readiness of all allies increases by 25% and the caster is granted increased Attack when a Dual Attack is triggered.

S3.name: Pierce
S3.description: Pierces the enemy's weak point with a spear, decreasing Combat Readiness by 50%.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Sword of the Kingdom
S1.description: Attacks with a sword, with a 50% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Shield Deflect
S2.description: The caster reflects 50% of the damage suffered from a critical hit to the attacker. Reflected damage can't be higher than caster's max Health.

S3.name: Strike
S3.description: Jumps towards the enemy and attacks them, dispelling all buffs and absorbing all damage as Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Lunge
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by diving at them with a chain axe, with a 50% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S2.name: Swift Movement
S2.description: When attacked, damage suffered in one attack does not exceed 51% of max Health. At the end of an enemy's turn, when the caster's Health is 70% or less, dispels all debuffs from the caster and grants stealth and vampirism for 1 turn before increasing Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Moonlight Shadow
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, with a 100% chance each to make them unable to be buffed for 2 turns and inflict silence for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the caster's lost Health.

S1.name: Dark Explosion
S1.description: Attacks two enemies with an explosion of dark energy, with a 70% chance to put them to sleep for 1 turn. When an enemy is put to sleep, the caster's Combat Readiness increases by 25%. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Ominous Thunder
S2.description: Summons ominous thunder to attack all enemies, dispelling one buff before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30% and before decreasing Speed and making them unable to be buffed for 2 turns.

S3.name: Nightmare
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by dropping the Moon of Nightmare, inflicting decreased Defense for 2 turns and a 85% chance to put them to sleep for 1 turn, before granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Rift Cleave
S1.description: Has a 85% chance to inflict seal on the enemy for 2 turns before attacking. When used on the caster's turn, has a 40% chance to activate Twisted Strike as an extra attack. Twisted Strike: Attacks all enemies, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and has a 35% chance to inflict fear for 1 turn. When the caster is granted engulf, effect chance is doubled.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases chance of activating Twisted Strike to 100%.

S2.name: Craving Affection
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants engulf. When attacking, penetrates the target's Defense, and cannot trigger a critical hit or heavy blow. After an ally uses a skill, for each debuff inflicted on all enemies, has a 25% chance to increase Combat Readiness by 15%

S3.name: Wave of Curses
S3.description: Has a 35% chance to inflict curse on all enemies except for the target for 2 turns before attacking the enemy, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. When the caster is granted engulf, effect chance is doubled.

S1.name: Demon Cutter
S1.description: Attacks with an axe, with a 75% chance to decrease Hit Chance for 1 turn.

S2.name: Dance of Sands
S2.description: A successful attack increases the Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 15%.

S3.name: Soul Break
S3.description: Strikes the enemy strongly, dealing damage proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Energy Blast
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with the suit's energy. Has a 40% chance to grant an extra attack with the same skill. When the enemy is not an Elite or Boss monster, ignores damage share.

S2.name: Victory Pose
S2.description: By manifesting the suit's power, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 20%, and grants increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Demolish
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 3 turns, attacks the enemy, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Grants stealth and a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. When the Speed of the caster is greater than the Speed of the target, penetration rate increases proportional to the difference, up to a maximum of 100%.
S3.soulburn_effect: All skill cooldowns decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Overreaction
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by whipping a ribbon, and grants a barrier to the caster for 1 turn. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Attack.
S1.soulburn_effect: Greatly increases damage dealt and does not trigger a Dual Attack. When the caster is granted cascade, does not cost any Soul to activate Soulburn.

S2.name: Delusional Runway
S2.description: Buffs granted to the caster are applied as undispellable. When attacked, damage suffered in one attack does not exceed 51% of max Health. At the start of the turn, has a 20% chance for each buff granted to the caster to grant cascade.

S3.name: Heart Over Grace
S3.description: Throws chocolates filled with heartfelt sentiments, granting increased Attack and increased Speed to all allies for 3 turns. Grants increased Hit Chance to the caster for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Lunge
S1.description: Attacks the enemy in an act of faith, with a 40% chance to stun for 1 turn. When it is not the caster's turn, effect chance increases by 20%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Chivalry
S2.description: Grants 40% damage share from the damage received by the ally in the back row. At the moment the ally in the back row is attacked, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15% and has a 35% chance to counterattack.

S3.name: Oath of Protection
S3.description: Swears an oath of protection, dispelling all debuffs from the caster and an ally, before increasing Defense for 3 turns. Grants class enhancement to the ally for 3 turns.

S1.name: Sundering Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, inflicting up to 10% injuries, before granting a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to the caster for 1 turn. When triggered as a counterattack, changes into an attack that targets all enemies.

S2.name: Wandering Eidolon
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, grants counterattack for 1 turn. At the end of an enemy's turn, gains 10 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, dispels all debuffs before increasing Combat Readiness by 100%.

S3.name: Sword of Requiem
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by unleashing the power of the demonic sword, before consuming all Fighting Spirit. Inflicts 5,000 additional damage, regardless of whether the attack hits, and additional damage increases proportional to the amount of consumed Fighting Spirit, up to 15,000. When this skill is not on cooldown, when attacked, grants 30% damage reduction.

S1.name: Sword Storm
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword blast, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Tatical Command
S2.description: Immune to debuffs which prevent movement. When the ally in the back row has a debuff which prevents movement after being attacked, activates Commanding Shout on the target. Commanding Shout: Dispels all debuffs from the ally and grants immunity and a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) for 2 turns.

S3.name: All-Out Attack
S3.description: Attacks all enemies again after a swordstorm, with a 100% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns, and increases Defense of all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Shield Thrust
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword and shield, with a 75% chance each to dispel one buff twice. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Escort
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the caster's turn, grants escort to the caster for 1 turn. After an ally except for the caster is attacked by a Single Attack, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Judgment of Light
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a shield, dispelling all buffs and a 100% chance to stun for 1 turn, before granting a barrier and increased Defense to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Pulse Deployment
S1.description: Attacks all enemies with light, with a 65% chance to dispel one buff. Deals 1000 additional damage regardless of whether the attack hits.

S2.name: Survivor's Mission
S2.description: At the start of battle, when in the front row, grants offense mission, and when in the back row, grants defense mission. When a mission is complete, dispels the mission and all debuffs from the caster, and activates Last Words of a Fallen Star. Last Words of a Fallen Star: Grants knowledge of the stars to all allies, and grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: Light Piercing the End
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a drone, dispelling all buffs before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Deals 3000 additional damage regardless of whether the attack hits.

S1.name: Zippity Zap!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When it is the caster's turn, gains 1 Focus. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases damage dealt and deals additional damage equivalent to 40% of injuries inflicted on the target.

S2.name: Wild Charge
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 30%. At the start of the first battle, gains 1 Focus. At the start of the turn, gains 1 Focus and grants Bzzt! to the caster for 1 turn, and when Focus is full, resets cooldown of Operation: Cream Pastry.

S3.name: Operation: Cream Pastry
S3.description: Attacks the enemy using adaptable tactics, inflicting up to 25% injuries, and grants increased Speed to all allies for 2 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. When Focus is full, consumes all to recover Health of the caster, and deals additional damage equivalent to 60% of injuries inflicted on the target. Damage dealt and amount recovered increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Ankle Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S2.name: Blade Gust
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a blade gust, with an 80% chance to make them unable to be buffed for 2 turns. When there are three or fewer enemies, damage dealt increases with fewer enemies.

S3.name: Gliding Slash
S3.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, granting increased Attack and Weakness Shared to the caster for 2 turns, before absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health. A critical hit has a 100% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S1.name: 速射
S1.description: 射撃で敵を攻撃し、発動者を除いて行動ゲージが最も高い味方の行動ゲージを15%増加させる。ターン終了時、対象の爆弾を爆発させる。

S2.name: ヴァンパイアハンター
S2.description: ターン開始時、敵全体の不死を解除する。効果抵抗を無視する。誰かのターン終了時、敵に不死があれば発動者の行動ゲージを50%増加させる。

S3.name: 連鎖爆発
S3.description: 敵を攻撃し、強化効果を二つ解除した後、2ターンの間防御力ダウンと爆弾を付与する。クリティカルが発生すると追加ターンを得る。

S1.name: Hilag's Pride
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Maelstrom Waltz
S2.description: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants counterattack to the caster for 3 turns.

S3.name: Promised Glory
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Quick Fire
S1.description: Rapidly shoots the enemy, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Precise Attack
S2.description: Fires a missile at the enemy, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction and grants torrent to the caster. Increases Hit Chance of this skill by 50%.

S3.name: Limiter Release
S3.description: Releases the limiter, granting increased Attack (Greater), increased Critical Hit Chance, and increased Hit Chance to the caster for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Sweep
S1.description: Rapidly attacks two enemies with a swordstorm. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Dancing Blade
S2.description: After an ally attacks, when the enemy's Health is 50% or less, grants increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns, and activates Dancing Blade. Dancing Blade: Attacks all enemies with a sword blast, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S3.name: Blade Ascent
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a swordstorm, dealing damage proportional to the caster's Speed.

S1.name: Graceful Cut
S1.description: Attacks with a sword, with a 75% chance to decrease Attack for 1 turn. When it is not the caster's turn, increases Combat Readiness by 15% and gains double the amount of Focus.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100% and decreases Attack of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Duel Accepted
S2.description: As preparation for a duel, dispels two debuffs from the caster and grants perception for 3 turns, before recovering 15% Health. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Butterfly Cut
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by piercing them with a sword before consuming all Focus. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of Focus consumed, and when consumed Focus is 5, resets the cooldown of Butterfly Cut. When Butterfly Cut is not on cooldown, increases Evasion by 35%, and when evading, counterattacks with Graceful Cut.

S1.name: Vitality Drain
S1.description: Smashes the enemy with a rock, increasing the caster's Combat Readiness by 15%. A critical hit will increase the caster's Combat Readiness by an additional 10%.

S2.name: Thunder God's Cry
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a thunderstorm. When an enemy is defeated, activates Thunder God's Cry once more. Each subsequent Thunder God's Cry activated this way deals decreased damage, and can be activated up to 3 times.

S3.name: Mana Amplification
S3.description: Fully amplifies mana, granting immunity to all allies for 3 turns before granting increased Attack (Greater) to the caster for 3 turns while increasing Attack of all allies except for the caster for 3 turns.

S1.name: Weak Point
S1.description: Shoots an arrow at the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 15%. When the enemy is targeted, increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Steady Aim
S2.description: Has a 100% chance to target a random enemy for 2 turns at the beginning of each turn.

S3.name: Fatal Shot
S3.description: Attacks the enemy's vital points, with a 100% chance to stun for 2 turn.

S1.name: Basic Shot
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting arrows, with a 50% chance to target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Concentrated Fire
S2.description: Fires arrows at the enemy to attack, dispelling one buff. When the caster has a buff, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S3.name: Shock Arrow
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting lightning arrows, inflicting silence and decreased Attack for 2 turns and decreasing Combat Readiness by 100%. Grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Spiral Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a machete, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and decreases Defense of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Natural Storyteller
S2.description: After an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates Continuous Strike against the enemy with the highest Combat Readiness. Continuous Strike: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Combat Readiness except for the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Narrative Retcon
S3.description: Plants a bomb on all enemies and decreases Speed for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Sniper
S1.description: Shoots the enemy with a rifle, with a 50% chance to target them for 2 turns.

S2.name: Quickfire
S2.description: Shoots all enemies with a rifle, with a 100% chance to dispel one buff, and increases Speed of the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Finishing Shot
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a mana bullet. Penetrates the target's Defense. Increases Hit Chance by 50% when using this skill.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Overpower
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict burn for 1 turn. When Merciless Execution is on cooldown, activates Annihilate instead of Overpower. Annihilate: Attacks the enemy, inflicting burn for 1 turn, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects inflicted on the target.
S1.soulburn_effect: Inflicts an additional burn effect for 1 turn.

S2.name: Operational Readiness
S2.description: Increases Effectiveness by 30%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. At the start of the first battle, grants explosives to the ally in the back row except for the caster.

S3.name: Merciless Execution
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, with a 100% chance each to inflict two burn effects for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects and bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Mirror Fragment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a mirror, with a 100% chance to inflict a random debuff for 1 turn. When Mirror of the Abyss is on cooldown, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Consuming Grasp
S2.description: After inflicting rupture on all enemies for 2 turns, attacks all enemies and has a 100% chance to inflict restrict for 2 turns. Grants stealth and a barrier (proportional to the Level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Mirror of the Abyss
S3.description: Traps all enemies in a timeless space beyond the mirror, dispelling two buffs before inflicting block for 2 turns and a random debuff for 1 turn. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

S1.name: Hide in the Shadows
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by swinging a sword, and has a 100% chance to grant stealth to the caster for 1 turn.

S2.name: Aegis of Time
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants increased Critical Hit Resistance to all allies for 2 turns. Upon dying, revives with 50% Health.

S3.name: Once-in-a-Life Research
S3.description: (Before Enhancement) Dispels all debuffs from all allies except for the caster and recovers Health before granting barrier for 2 turns. Amount recovered and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health. Grants solution to the caster and decreases skill cooldowns by 2 turns. (After Enhancement) Grants time reversal to all allies except for the caster and grants a barrier proportional to the caster's max Health to all allies except for the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Lunging Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When used on the caster's turn, activate Dazzling Slash as an extra attack if the caster is buffed. Dazzling Slash: Swiftly attacks the enemy, inflicting restrict for 1 turn.

S2.name: Assault Coordination
S2.description: After attacking four times, grants a barrier to all allies for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 15%. Barrier strength increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S3.name: Battle Cry
S3.description: Raises the morale of all allies, granting increased Attack and immunity for 2 turns and decreasing debuff durations by 1 turn.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Oopsie!
S1.description: Accidentally spills bread to attack the enemy, and triggers a Dual Attack from a random ally, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%.
S1.soulburn_effect: Combat Readiness increase effect will be applied to all allies.

S2.name: No Bullying!
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 40 Fighting Spirit, and when the foremost ally except for the caster is an Earth elemental Hero, gains 40 additional Fighting Spirit, before granting Special Friendship to the target. After being attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit and when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all to dispel all debuffs from the caster before activating Help! Help!: Attacks all enemies, and grants an extra turn to the caster. A successful attack deals additional damage equivalent to 15% of max Health of the caster and the foremost ally except for the caster.

S3.name: Snack Time!
S3.description: Stops fighting and takes a break, dispelling all debuffs from all allies and granting continuous healing for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by 20%.

S1.name: Double Slash
S1.description: Attacks by swinging their weapon, with a 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Dragon's Roar
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a dragon howl, dispelling one buff, before a 70% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns and a 85% chance to silence for 1 turn.

S3.name: Dragon Charge
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns, attacks the enemy with a massive blade. When the enemy is defeated, grants an extra turn. When the target has a debuff, increases damage dealt. When this skill is not on cooldown, after an ally except for the caster uses a skill, if the enemy has a debuff, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S1.name: 残酷な手
S1.description: 敵を攻撃し、100%の確率で1ターンの間転換挑発を付与する。発動者の最大HPに比例して与ダメージがアップする。

S2.name: 悪意の微笑み
S2.description: 攻撃されると、受けたダメージの40%を攻撃者に反射する。反射ダメージは発動者の最大HPを超えない。攻撃された後HPが30%以下なら、発動者の弱体効果をすべて解除して殺意を発動する。攻撃された後の効果は5ターンごとに一度のみ発動できる。殺意：発動者に3ターンの間バリア（最大HPに比例）を付与し、行動ゲージを25%増加させる。

S3.name: 苦痛の交響曲
S3.description: 加虐の球体を解き放って敵を攻撃し、敵を倒すと最大HPに比例して発動者のHPを回復する。対象がエリートまたはボスモンスターでない場合、ダメージ分散を無視する。対象の防御力を貫通するが、クリティカルや強打は発生しない。発動者の失ったHPに比例して与ダメージがアップする。
S3.soulburn_effect: 与ダメージがアップする。

S1.name: Homing Laser
S1.description: Attacks all enemies with a drone, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%, and increasing Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 5%.

S2.name: Upgrade
S2.description: Enhances all allies with a drone, granting increased Attack and increased Speed for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Meteor Cannon
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a cannon. When there are three or fewer enemies, damage dealt increases with fewer enemies.

S1.name: Vulnerability Exposed
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a longsword. Increases Hit Chance and Critical Hit Chance of this skill by 50%. When the target has a buff, increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Elaborate Plan
S2.description: Dispels two debuffs from an ally before increasing Combat Readiness of the ally by 30%. Grants increased Attack and increased Hit Chance to the caster for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Execute
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, inflicting up to 35% injuries, before granting invincibility to the caster for 1 turn. Increases Critical Hit Chance and Hit Chance of this skill by 50%.

S1.name: Vampirism
S1.description: Claws the enemy, before absorbing some of the damage as Health.

S2.name: Vengeful Strike
S2.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 55% before decreasing Speed of the enemy for 2 turns and increasing Speed of the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Spiteful Annihilation
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling all buffs and making them unable to be buffed for 2 turns, before increasing Attack and Defense of the caster for 2 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Black Thorn
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with thorns, inflicting frostbite for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

S2.name: Star's Armor
S2.description: Decreases the enemy's Evasion by 50%. At the start of the turn, when an enemy is inflicted with frostbite, grants rage and increased Defense to the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Ancient Beast
S3.description: Summons an ancient beast to attack all enemies, dispelling two buffs before inflicting rupture and cannot buff for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense. When the caster is granted rage, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Ice Shard
S1.description: Attacks an enemy with an ice pick, with a 50% chance to decrease Speed for 2 turns.

S2.name: Ice Pick
S2.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. When the target has a debuff, increases damage dealt.

S3.name: Iceberg
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a giant iceberg, with a 75% chance to stun for 1 turn.

S1.name: Let Me Destroy You
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, before increasing Attack of the caster for 1 turn. When the caster is deified, activates Disappear as an extra attack. Disappear can only be activated once per turn, during the caster's turn. Disappear: Attacks the enemy with a swordstorm, and when the enemy is defeated, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

S2.name: Supreme Authority
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases Combat Readiness by 30%. Unaffected by effects that reduce Combat Readiness increases the caster receives.

S3.name: Bow Down Before Me
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling two buffs before silencing for 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 40%. Grants deify to the caster for 3 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 100% and cannot trigger a critical hit. When the target is a Hero, damage dealt increases proportional to the target's current Health.
